headline.caveat: multi-year partnership; duration and minimum-spend structure undisclosed

nature_md: Announced Feb 2026: a multi-year, $200M partnership embedding OpenAI's models natively in Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, letting Snowflake's 12,600+ customers build agents and natural-language analytics grounded in governed enterprise data. Mirrors the $200M Anthropic deal signed two months earlier — Snowflake explicitly refuses model lock-in, so the identical price points function as a rough public benchmark for what platform-scale frontier-model access costs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Committed model-access spend — cost of revenue behind Cortex AI consumption; recovered through customer credit consumption with platform markup.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: For OpenAI: committed multi-year enterprise-channel revenue independent of its investor-suppliers — the demand-quality datapoint bulls point to, though $200M is <1% of OpenAI's ARR and small against its compute obligations.
